title: Monitorability Is Trainable: Post-Training for Chain-of-Thought Monitorability
abstract: arXiv:2610.29734v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is one of the few practical tools available for overseeing capable AI systems, but it is fragile: a model's reasoning is only useful to a monitor if it remains coupled to what the model actually does. This coupling can be degraded during training through, for example, CoT compression, optimization against a monitor, and out-of-context generalization from synthetic documents. In this work, we propose an unsupervised post-training objective based on maximizing mutual information between CoT and the output for improving CoT monitorability. Across three model organisms with degraded CoT, it recovers most or all of the lost monitorability. Applied to undegraded policies, it further improves judged monitorability, improves prediction of unsafe behavior by CoT monitors and activation probes, and increases the prevalence of consequential reasoning. translated_title: 可监控性是可训练的：面向思维链可监控性的后训练
translated_abstract: 思维链监控是为数不多的可用于监督强人工智能系统的实用工具之一，但它十分脆弱：模型的推理只有在与模型的实际行为保持耦合时，才能对监控者有用。这种耦合可能会在训练过程中被削弱，例如通过思维链压缩、针对监控器的优化，以及来自合成文档的上下文外泛化。在本工作中，我们提出了一种无监督的后训练目标，通过最大化思维链与输出之间的互信息来提升思维链的可监控性。在三个具有退化思维链的模型载体上，该方法恢复了大部分乃至全部损失的可监控性。将该目标应用于未退化的策略时，它能进一步提升经评估的可监控性，增强思维链监控器和激活探针对不安全行为的预测能力，并提高“后果性推理”的出现频率。这些结果表明，可监控性应当被视为一种……
tldr: 本文提出了一种通过最大化思维链与输出之间互信息的无监督后训练目标，能够恢复退化模型损失的思维链可监控性，并进一步提升未退化模型的监控效果与不安全行为预测能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an unsupervised post-training objective that maximizes mutual information between chain-of-thought and outputs, recovering most or all of degraded CoT monitorability and further improving monitoring and prediction of unsafe behavior in undegraded policies.
